metaTitle: Custom Full Color Tape Measures | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color tape measures for your brand. Ideal for giveaways and promotions. Get a quote today at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Full color decoration on tape measures lets you reproduce logos, photos, or detailed artwork with sharp, vibrant results. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to showcase gradients, fine text, and complex brand imagery across the entire tape body or case. This makes custom full color tape measures a smart choice for promotional giveaways where visual impact matters—trade shows, safety events, or customer appreciation kits. Choose a model like the Transparent Tape-A-Matic or Tape Measure with LED Flashlight to combine utility with eye-catching color.
heroAltText: Custom full color tape measures with vibrant logo imprint on the case and tape blade
